subject: Shade
status: CLOTHING DIRECTION REJECTED by Jacob as too much like Harry Potter; superseded by v4 embodied-regalia proposal. Preserved face/body are not separately owner-locked.

inputImages.role: Edit target; clothing rejected, other features preserved to respect narrow request, without asserting their approval

ownerRequest: bro fix clothing wtf is that ?
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit this existing SHADE concept sheet. CHANGE HER CLOTHING ONLY and update the clothing visible in the matching portrait/detail insets. The current costume is a failed draft: it has a huge impossible hovering sleeve, too many tiny overlapping skirt flaps, a large fabric puddle, and indistinct attachment points.

PRESERVE EXACTLY: the same adult female alien character, facial likeness and knowing expression, two-eye anatomy, biological cranial ridges, indigo-pearl skin material and colour, body proportions, hands and finger poses, solid black/gold codex and its diagrams, the camera and three-quarter pose, the full-body-left / portrait-upper-right / book-detail-lower-right composition, background, lighting, title and subtitle. Do not change her anatomy, face, head, book, or add a weapon. Preserve existing body augmentation except where a garment must fit over it. No new injuries or character redesign.

REPLACE THE GARMENTS WITH ONE COHERENT, WEARABLE DARK ASTRAL PRIEST-SHAMAN OUTFIT:
Use THREE clearly distinguishable ceremonial layers with deliberate construction, clear seams and fastenings. True black cloth, dark violet lining only within folds, a small amount of polished volcanic glass and restrained worn ancient gold. A refined, severe scholar's silhouette with enough room to move.

1. A modest asymmetric COWL AND SHORT SHOULDER MANTLE. Keep the face open and visible, simplify the hood to two broad folds. The mantle fastens at ONE small broken cult seal near the collarbone and ends above the elbows. Its shape frames her shoulders closely; it does not extend behind her into a giant cape or plume. No pointed shoulder armour or enormous collar.
2. A fitted black wrapped upper robe, closed securely at the waist with a narrow sculpted obsidian fastening. A clean diagonal overlapping front with visible edge and seam. Deep neckline only enough to retain the current exposed upper chest/neck material; elegant, not revealing or lingerie-like. Sleeves FIT the upper arms and end just below the elbows; exposed forearms and hands remain clearly visible to work with the codex. No hanging fabric attached to wrists or book, and no massive open bell sleeves.
3. A controlled layered LOWER ROBE: straight, softly tapered inner layer ending at the ankles; two broad outer ceremonial panels attached visibly to the waist, one ending slightly higher than the other. A modest walking split allows one existing lower leg/foot to read. Use just a few long deep folds. No high fashion thigh slit, tiny scales of fabric, curtain ruffles, endless rag strips, giant skirt, train or fabric pooling on the floor. Entire hem stays just above the ground. The lower silhouette occupies roughly her shoulder width plus a little walking room, not half the canvas.

The garments must look purpose-built for an original dark astral cult: minimal gold seam accents and one subtle repeated diagram border, not generic decorative embroidery everywhere. No bodice armour cups, corset lacing, zippers, medieval leather belts, neon piping, feather capes or wings. Polished volcanic-glass details should have large restrained facets integrated into the garment fastenings, not cover her whole body.

REMOVE the entire raised cloth arc on the right and the excessive trailing left-side cloth. Fill the cleared space with the same plain studio background. Every retained piece of fabric must have a clear attachment and hang with convincing gravity. Preserve the idea of a layered/shifting silhouette through staggered hems, asymmetric overlap and one lightly displaced edge, rather than unsupported fabric floating above her. Keep black haze very thin and close to the robe/forearms, no long smoke ropes bridging empty space.

Ensure the portrait shows the SAME simpler cowl/mantle and the book inset shows the SAME fitted sleeves and uncovered forearms. Keep the character recognisable without alteration. High-quality, tactile cloth and polished obsidian; confident broad shape design, clean silhouette and readable wearer anatomy. One edited sheet, no alternatives.
inspection: Visually inspected result. Removed raised unsupported drape, long smoke ropes and pooled ragged train. New small cowl/shoulder mantle fastens at collarbone; wrap top, fitted upper sleeves ending at elbows, waist fastening and broad staggered robe panels have readable construction. Hem clears floor, leg/feet visible. Face, cranial anatomy, hands/book gesture, skin family and composition visually retained; portrait and book detail show matching garment changes. Outfit covers more skin and reads more conventional than the original shifting-silhouette concept; these are owner-review points, not approved refinements or new design locks.
scope: Single clothing edit only. No new character anatomy, injury, lore, gameplay powers, other Pal work, PixelLab, production sprite/animation/Unity/code/build changes, commits or pushes.
